title: Weekly Mood Scale, Safety Plan, and When to Seek Emergency Help
summary: A practical tool for parents: (1) Weekly mood scale (1-10 chart for mood/energy/sleep) — a decline for more than two weeks = visit a specialist. (2) Personal safety plan: their warning signs, calming strategies, people they trust, and your country's emergency number and mental-health helpline. (3) Emergency: suicidal thoughts, a specific plan, available means, previous self-harm — call your country's emergency number immediately or go to the nearest emergency department, and do not leave them alone.
try_this: This week: Create a pocket-sized "safety card" together — write: 3 warning signs, 3 calming strategies, 3 people your child trusts, and your country's emergency number. Keep it in a wallet or on the phone.
reflection_prompts: Was the card easy to understand?
Did your son feel safe having it?
